title: Space Day 2025
description: Our flagship event: a full day dedicated to AI, Earth observation and space engineering, with guest speakers, project showcases and hands-on demos.

title: Conference — Space Architecture & Analog Astronautics
description: A conference with Ismail El Omari, space architect and analog astronaut, on designing habitats for life beyond Earth and what analog missions teach us.

title: Astronomy Night
description: An open-sky observation evening with the club telescope — planets, deep-sky objects and an introduction to celestial navigation.

title: Aero Day 2026
description: A full day celebrating aeronautics: RC flight demos, flight-simulation challenges, industry talks and department project showcases.

title: Company Visit — Safran Casablanca
description: A guided visit of Safran's facilities in Casablanca to see aerospace manufacturing and MRO operations up close.

title: Workshop — Intro to Aerodynamics & CAD
description: A hands-on session for new members: lift, drag and stability fundamentals, then your first aircraft part in SolidWorks.

title: Marrakech Air Show Challenge
description: The club competes in a national aerospace challenge on the sidelines of the Marrakech Air Show.
